description: Queue a manual re-sync for an integration: customers and revenue for a payment provider (Stripe, Polar, Paddle, Dodo, Lemon Squeezy, Creem, Chargebee, Whop), the user backfill for Supabase, or the event-history import for PostHog and Segment. Use this for Supabase before a campaign that depends on names or plan attributes - the live trigger only sends rows that change after it was installed, so existing users have no attributes until a backfill runs. The Supabase sync reads the project, schema, and table already configured for the integration and cannot be pointed at a different table; if none is configured yet it fails saying so. This is also the supported way to retry a failed PostHog or Segment history import: it restarts from the beginning using the stored credentials, and already-imported events dedupe, so a re-run cannot duplicate them. Returns immediately - poll get_integration to watch `syncStatus` and `lastSyncAt`, and list_integration_activity for per-row outcomes. Fails with a conflict if a sync is already queued or running; terminal BullMQ failures release history imports for retry. Providers whose backfill is not API-triggerable (Shopify products, Affonso affiliates) return a clear error naming the dashboard. Check `availableActions` on get_integration to see whether this is supported before calling.
